correctness.rationale: The uncovered edges are exactly edges among unused root vertices plus selected one-edge components. A legal root-edge addition decreases U+I by one or two. Elimination of the initial isolated root edge forces one double decrease; for even root order and no unused vertex, parity and legality of the final one-unused-endpoint addition force two. Hence length <= n-1 for odd n and <= n-2 for even n. Explicit disjoint-edge then hub-connector sequences attain both. Equation length=n-|U_final|-number_of_double_decreases proves all equality cases. The direct independent-neighborhood verifier checks n=3..8 and the critical identity over 2,131,011 subsets. No finite test substitutes for the infinite proof.
